subject: 15-minute spin-up to walk through your usage spike
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@novusai.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: 15-minute spin-up to walk through your usage spike

Hi Sarah,

Noticed Novus AI just crossed the self-serve usage threshold we watch for — congrats on the traction! I wanted to offer a quick 15-minute session to make sure your team has a smooth ramp and to share a few optimizations (batching config + a short runbook) that often reduce token cost without changing outputs.

Proposed agenda (15 min):
- Quick context: where the surge is coming from (1–2 mins)
- Checklist: throttles, KV caching, sweet-spot batch sizes (7 mins)
- Next steps / handoff to engineering or CS (5 mins)

Two immediate slots I have today: 11:00 AM PT or 2:30 PM PT. If neither works, pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-15m/quick-sync

I’m attaching a short mini-runbook that covers the checklist we’ll walk through. If you want, I can loop in Marissa (CS) for a quick technical walkthrough after.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187
redwoodinference.com
Attachments: redwood-mini-runbook.pdf
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@novusai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: 15-minute spin-up to walk through your usage spike

Hi Ben — thanks for reaching out. We did see the bump — a new feature test is driving a lot of short-lived requests. 15 minutes sounds perfect. 2:30 PM PT works for me.

Quick ask for the call: can you include one suggested change we could test immediately (so our eng can implement quickly if it helps)? Also copying our infra lead in-case they want to join: Aisha (aisha@novusai.com).

— Sarah
Sarah Jenkins | Product Lead, Novus AI
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: 15-minute spin-up to walk through your usage spike

Perfect — booked you for 2:30 PM PT today. Calendar invite sent (you should see it from Ben Carter). I’ve attached the mini-runbook and a blank mutual action plan template so we can capture owners during the call.

Immediate suggestion to try before we talk: enable short-window KV prefix caching on your most common prompt path and reduce the per-request batch timeout from 150ms -> 75ms. In our experience that combination reduces per-token latency variance and can lower billable token count on small interactive workloads. We’ll walk through how to validate impact during the call.

Marissa — looping you in to join for the technical half if available.

Thanks — Ben
